# Section copied mask

One bit per section, set when its copy returns; not proof its constructors have run.

**Category:** data · **Address:** `0xa32de590` (runtime uncached) · <span class="pill pill-beta">Corroborated</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om3 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om3-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-3](../cameras/om3.md)

The loader is its only writer and stock code never reads it. Constructors finish later: their bits are in the phase mask at 0xa32de58c, set after each section's static constructors.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Olympus firmware research](../projects/oly-fw-analysis.md)): The loader sets a loaded bit here. Source: [Finding space for added code](../sources/fishcu.code-space.md).
- **Emulator** ([OM-Emu](../projects/om-emu.md)): A scan finds only the loader's two references; with the loader modelled it reads 0x3ff at open. Source: [OM-Emu study of Caduceus OM-3](../sources/emu.caduceus-om3.md).
